verdict.rationale: IRCC runs its own public processing-times checker where users select their application type to see how long it takes. It also publishes the method: times reflect how long it took to process 80% of that application type in the past. That clearly covers service-published processing times per transaction type. However, the times are backward-looking rather than truly current, and the evidence never confirms that the founder's own route (Start-up Visa or work permit) appears as a selectable type. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that Start-up Visa/founder application types are listed in the checker, real-time or current rather than historical-80% times, independent or hands-on corroboration.
